method: 70+ digit interval transfer matrices and characteristic derivatives; interval Sturm-Pruefer node counts for the first 82 global roots; exact characteristic-function residues for modes i=2,...,80; Neumann-bracketing eigenvalue lower bounds and Lagrange-identity residue growth bounds for the infinite tail; degree-8 centered Taylor enclosures for N_X on 426 time boxes.
assumptions_and_dependencies: The first right-half root R1 is reused from the existing certified Q30 root bracket.
The full operator is the fixed static equal-resistance three-layer Robin benchmark with kappa=4.
Neumann bracketing is applied after releasing interface continuity and dropping the positive Robin boundary terms.
The residue-growth bound uses the exact characteristic-function residue formula and the Lagrange norm identity.
scope: This certificate proves N_X<0 only on [0.0015,0.010]. Combined with the existing late-time certificate, psi_X' has exactly one sign change on [0.0015,infinity). It does not cover (0,0.0015).
